evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-update，把共享库里所有能追踪来源的 Skill 更新掉，本地自建的不要碰。
evals.expected_output: Inventory and back up the shared library, run the global Skills CLI update, refresh only previously installed well-known Skills, verify the post-update inventory, and skip local or untracked Skills.
expectations: Targets the shared/global installed Skill library
Creates and verifies a recovery copy before mutation
Runs skills update with explicit global non-interactive scope
Does not update AI coding tool binaries or plugins

evals.prompt: freshkeeper update。上游如果删了某个 Skill，不要跟着删；也不要顺便安装仓库里新出现的 Skill。
evals.expected_output: Update only pre-existing source-tracked Skill names in non-interactive mode, skip upstream deletions, avoid --all, and verify no pre-update Skill disappeared.
expectations: Does not delete Skills removed upstream
Does not use --all or add newly discovered Skills
Compares the full inventory before and after
Restores and reports any pre-existing Skill that disappears
